author: ValWood
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete  GO:0019408 dolichol biosynthetic process
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29877

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LCrpKhFUabpIIeN-qrRSltwRlE3dhh_l66fuhwu7du8/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
   1 CGD 
   5 SGD
   5 UniProt
   6 TIGR
   1 MGI
Will be automigrated to GO:0043048 dolichyl monophosphate biosynthetic process

   2 ComplexPortal  
   1 GeneDB
   2 PomBase
   2 TAIR



Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 

GO:0019408 | interpro2go | InterPro:IPR038887 Dehydrodolichyl diphosphate synthase complex subunit Nus1 > GO:dolichol biosynthetic process ; GO:0019408







Thanks.
